name: Borgar Quest VN
source:
BORGAR QUEST VN is a comical multi-path visual novel with RPG and dating sim elements about a guy who goes to get a burger in a small town, full of zombies.

Inspired by the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r8URxIA95SU]Death Burger[/url] skit by Psychostick and a real life restaurant.

[From [url=https://borgarlover.itch.io/borgar-quest-vnhttps://borgarlover.itch.io/borgar-quest-vn]itch.io[/url]]
